purpose: Predeclare how new fixed-white Compositae1061 samples may be promoted into the flower-colour rate tree without changing loci or choosing samples/topologies to favor a colour history.

public_status.Cirsium boninense: MIG-seq method and five-taxon comparison are public, but sample/voucher detail, reusable raw/genotype data and a Compositae1061-compatible tip are not recovered
public_status.Cirsium wulongense: primary white-corolla taxonomy is public, but no exact public homologous nuclear asset is recovered

individual_recovery_gate.clean_recovered_definition: A frozen locus has one usable recovered DNA sequence for that individual and no HybPiper paralog count >1 for that individual at that locus.
individual_recovery_gate.paralog_handling: Mask only the affected new individual at that locus; do not remove the locus from the frozen 153-locus matrix because of a new-sample paralog warning.
individual_recovery_gate.unrecovered_locus_handling: Encode the new individual as missing/gaps at that frozen locus; do not backfill with a different locus.
individual_recovery_gate.non_gap_aligned_bp_fraction_role: descriptive QC and deterministic representative tie-break only; it is not a post hoc locus filter

required_linkage: flower-colour record linked to the sequenced individual
replicate_identity_gate.identity_conflict_policy: Any unresolved taxonomic, contamination or sample-identity conflict blocks species-level promotion.
replicate_identity_gate.placement_concordance_rule: Before collapsing replicates to one species tip, all minimum passing individuals must form one species-level clade in the replicate-expanded primary tree and that replicate clade must remain intact across all topology candidates retained by the predeclared topology-sensitivity procedure. Failure is a stop condition, not a reason to choose the individual with the preferred colour history.
replicate_identity_gate.state_counting_rule: Multiple samples of one species are never counted as multiple white macroevolutionary tips.
replicate_identity_gate.reticulation_policy: If passing individuals are not placement-concordant, retain them as diagnostic replicates and resolve taxonomy, hybridization/polyploidy or contamination before any species-level rate-tree promotion.

selection_order: highest clean recovered frozen-153 locus count
highest non-gap aligned base count across the frozen-153 matrix
forbidden_criteria: flower-colour history favoured by the sample
preferred topology beyond the predeclared placement-concordance gate
species_representative_rule.replicate_sensitivity: All non-primary concordant samples remain available for representative-swap sensitivity rather than being discarded.

expanded_tree_gate.trigger: Both A1 species have passed individual recovery, identity, phenotype and replicate-placement gates and are ready for species-level representatives.
expanded_tree_gate.locus_policy: Rebuild all per-locus alignments and the concatenated matrix using the same frozen 153 loci. New-sample missing/paralog loci are gaps; the locus universe is not reselected after seeing the two white taxa.
expanded_tree_gate.tree_inference_policy: Infer a new branch-length tree for the exact 22 eligible focal taxa plus OUTGROUP_saff; do not graft new taxa onto the old 20-tip tree with invented branch lengths.
expanded_tree_gate.topology_policy: Re-run structural alignment QC, primary tree acceptance and a newly evaluated topology-concordance/sensitivity gate on the expanded tree. The old six AU-nonrejected 20-tip topologies are prior uncertainty evidence, not an automatically valid final 22-tip topology ensemble.
expanded_tree_gate.tip_join_policy: The final rate-tree contract must contain exactly the same accepted taxon names as the expanded rate-fit atlas before rate fitting can start.

decision.next_data_requirement: Populate at least two mandatory intake slots per A1 species with voucher/flower-colour-linked paired reads, then run the frozen-153 individual recovery evaluator; equivalent public homologous data may be used if they satisfy the same intake contract.
decision.claim_limit: This contract fixes the promotion procedure before new white-tip data are observed. Passing W>=5 is an engineering gate only. Rate inference still requires the rebuilt exact-tip tree, propagation of topology/branch-length uncertainty, sampling-bias assessment, polymorphic-state treatment and model-adequacy checks.
